faults.title: Automatic gearbox glitches (Mk7, 2013-2019)
faults.description: Carbuyer lists glitches and failures of the automatic gearbox among the Mk7's common problems. Test any automatic carefully and ask for evidence of servicing and any gearbox work.

faults.title: Leaking dampers (Mk7)
faults.description: Leaking dampers are named as a common Mk7 problem. Look for oil on the dampers and listen for knocks over bumps on a test drive.

faults.title: Headlight failure (Mk7)
faults.description: Headlight failures are listed among the Mk7's known faults. Check both headlights work on dipped and main beam before buying.

faults.title: Broken timing chains on some petrol engines (Mk7)
faults.description: Carbuyer says timing chains have broken on some Mk7 petrol engines. The page doesn't say which engines. A full service history is described as crucial, so ask for it and for any chain work.

faults.title: Electric handbrake and driver's wiper
faults.description: Electric handbrake faults are reported on the Mk7, though the page calls it largely reliable and says owners are divided. A smearing driver's wiper is usually cured by fitting upgraded blades.
